extracted.name: Mango Margarita
extracted.description: This frozen mango margarita is SO refreshing and delicious! It's the perfect drink for Cinco de Mayo or summer entertaining.
ingredient_lines: 3 cups cubed frozen mango (from about 4 small mangos)
¼ cup fresh lime juice (plus lime slices for garnish)
Sea salt ( for the glass rims, optional)
instruction_lines: Place the mango, lime juice, tequila, and Cointreau in a blender and blend until smooth. Add the ice and blend to the desired consistency. If the mixture is too thick to blend, let it sit and melt for a few minutes.
If desired, use a lime wedge to moisten the rims of the glasses and then dip the rims in a small plate of salt.
Pour the mango mixture into the glasses and garnish with lime slices.
